arguments.body:

1. Disconnect the speaker from your phone's Bluetooth settings
2. Press and hold the power button on the speaker until the light flashes blue (pairing mode)
3. Connect from your laptop's Bluetooth settings

Let me know if you run into any issues!

TechMart Support

arguments.subject: Bluetooth Speaker Pairing Steps
arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

As we discussed, here are the steps to switch devices with your Portable Bluetooth Speaker:

1. Disconnect the speaker from your phone's Bluetooth settings
2. Press and hold the power button on the speaker until the light flashes blue (pairing mode)
3. Connect from your laptop's Bluetooth settings

Let me know if you run into any issues!

TechMart Support
